definition: I. [ סָכַר ] verb shut up, stop up (Aramaic סְכַר , shut up, stop up, dam up ; Arabic fill, stop up, dam (river), etc., also also close, stop up door, Lane 1390 ; Assyrian sikêru , dam up , II. 2. stop ears ; compare sikkuru, bolt Dl HWB 499 ; apparently kindr. with סגר ; — hence Egyptian t&213;akar , barrier , Bondi 88 ); — Niph`al Imperfect 3 masculine singular ׳ יִסָּכֵר פִּי וגו Ps 63:12 the mouth of liars shall be stopped ; 3 masculine plural וַיִּסָּֽכְרוּ Gen 8:2 ( P ) and the springs of the deep etc., were shut up . Pi`el Perfect וְסִכַרְתִּ֫י אֶתמִֿצְרַיִם בְּיַד Isa 19:4 and I will shut up (deliver) Egypt into the hand of , etc. (compare סגר , מגן ).
